## Exposure data

Fard P, Hügel J, Conte Keivabu R, Dominici F, Zagheni E, Estiri H, Patel CJ. **Developing a spatiotemporal repository of extreme heat and cold exposure in the United States for precision public health research.** *Environmental Science & Technology.* 2025;59(37):19872–19884. [doi:10.1021/acs.est.5c03658](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.est.5c03658)

:   The GridEX paper. Data: [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/DJGKDJ), [Figshare](https://figshare.com/s/aab128348a1d0c8a4988/articles/24993447). Code: [github.com/epedram/us_ehe_ece](https://github.com/epedram/us_ehe_ece). Catalog: [interactive explorer](https://ehce.connect.hms.harvard.edu/us_ehe_ece).

Fard P, Chung MKJ, Estiri H, Patel CJ. **Spatio-temporal interpolation and delineation of extreme heat events in California between 2017 and 2021.** *Environmental Research.* 2023;237(Pt 2):116984. [doi:10.1016/j.envres.2023.116984](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envres.2023.116984)

:   The method GridEX builds on. Code: [github.com/epedram/ehmi](https://github.com/epedram/ehmi).
